title: Minimum certificate-cover cost per open S5 parent on the head-1476 open non-STERILE row state
method: Per parent: target rows = open non-STERILE rows whose 5-stone canon parent set contains the parent. Candidate roots = D4-canonical 7-stone extensions of the target rows (phase-1 global enumeration, each row's candidate count asserted equal to its published own_candidates_s6_s7_edge_cost). Lower bound = ceil(r/maxspan) by elementary incidence counting; exact when a witness of that size is exhibited (for maxspan<=2: disjoint pair roots + at most one singleton = matching, found by deterministic greedy matching with 60 restarts). Every witness is machine-verified at build time to cover exactly the target rows with distinct roots, and each witness root's generating (row, bit) occurrences satisfy canon(row|1<<bit) == root. The output lists witness roots as hexes; the full generating detail is reproducible by rerunning the published phase-1 and phase-2 scripts (~45s total).
interpretation_guard: Bookkeeping and combinatorics only. The 'minimum cover cost' is the smallest number of candidate roots whose hypothetical certificates would cover all remaining rows of a parent; it presumes every chosen root would actually validate and implies nothing about WIN/REFUTED outcomes. REFUTED-D10 and STERILE are not LOSS proofs.
unknown_status: Standard 11x11 empty board, two-stone roots {49,60}/{59,60}, S2 {59,60}, and classes 1/2/4 remain UNKNOWN.
